title: eludite/project/editItems
description: Edit a project's items for the Workspace window (brief 0073): Include In Project, Exclude From Project, the project side of a file rename, move or delete, an F# file's compile order, and an SDK project's empty folder. The project file keeps its formatting (MSBuild's construction model with PreserveFormatting, as eludite/project/setProperty writes); paths are written project-relative with `\` as Visual Studio writes them. When anything changed the host reloads the solution (the generation advances, as after a property write) and the shell asks for the tree again.

project.description: Absolute path of the project file (.csproj, .vbproj or .fsproj).

edits.description: Applied in order to one in-memory project; written once at the end when any changed it.

op.description: include: make the file (or every file under the folder) an item. SDK project: a Remove element that excludes it is deleted, else an item `<T Include="rel" />` is added; legacy: the item is added. exclude: SDK project: `<T Remove="rel" />` (a folder: `rel\**`) for an item a glob brings in, or the explicit element deleted; legacy: the element deleted. rename: every Include, Remove and Update naming `path` (or a path under the folder `path`) and every DependentUpon naming it rewritten to `to`. remove: every element naming `path` (or a path under it) deleted (after the file was deleted). moveUp and moveDown: the Compile element of `path` swapped with the previous or next Compile element (F# compile order). addFolder: `<Folder Include="rel\" />` in an SDK project when no item lies under the folder.

path.description: Absolute path of the file or folder.

itemType.description: include: the item type to add (Compile, Content, None, EmbeddedResource, ...). Default: by extension: .cs, .vb and .fs Compile; .resx EmbeddedResource; in a web project .cshtml, .razor, .html, .css, .js, .json and the WebForms markup Content; otherwise None.

generation.description: The solution generation after the call (advanced when changed).

edits.description: One per edit of the params, in order.

applied.description: The edit changed the project (false: nothing named the path, or nothing was needed).

message.description: Why nothing changed, when it is worth saying (a legacy project for addFolder, the first item for moveUp).
